whatThisPluginAdds.text: Hero adds a Layout Builder hero widget with page copy, actions, responsive images or video, multiple slides, and inherited theme background options.

surfaceOutcome.text: Editors configure the hero through Layout Builder and theme or widget background fields, while visitors receive the responsive hero rendered by the active theme.

developers.text: Prepared Data objects and resolution Actions keep media and background decisions outside Blade, and tests enforce query-free public rendering without editor metadata.

teams.text: Teams can establish reusable home-page defaults and still change copy, media, slides, and background treatment per widget without replacing unrelated page content.
